title: 🔐 Nikhil reused one password... the cost was every other login #passwords #2fa
title_alts: 🔑 Nikhil's leaked password fed credential stuffing... how that works #passwords #privacy
🧯 Nikhil kept one password everywhere... stop the chain reaction #passwords #accounts
description_hook: One password shared across a dozen logins is one leak away from all of them. Here is the order to fix it in.
setting: a home desk with a laptop and a phone
protagonist_type: an ordinary person with too many logins

characters.name: Nikhil
characters.description: thirty-two, short black hair, grey zip hoodie, a chipped enamel mug always within reach

claims.claim: Software tries your pair on hundreds of sites.
claims.basis: round illustrative order of magnitude for automated login attempts, not a measured count

claims.claim: Say you reuse one password across twelve accounts.
claims.basis: round illustrative assumption, stated as such in the narration
arithmetic: all twelve accounts share the single leaked password

claims.claim: Nine doors stay open, all with the same key.
claims.basis: arithmetic: twelve stated accounts minus the three changed in the example

scenes.narration: One leaked password can unlock every account that shares it.
scenes.caption: एक लीक हुआ पासवर्ड हर उस खाते को खोल देता है जहाँ वही लगा है।
scenes.image_brief: A single small brass key lying on a dark wooden desk beside nine identical closed padlocks arranged in a neat row, one warm desk lamp lighting them from the left, deep shadows behind.

scenes.narration: Breached site data gets bundled and sold in bulk lists.
scenes.caption: हैक हुई साइटों का डेटा बड़ी सूचियों में बंडल होकर बिकता है।
scenes.image_brief: A plain text file open on a laptop screen in a dim room, showing a long column of email addresses each followed by a password, the pale screen glow the only light in the room.

scenes.narration: Your email is the username almost everywhere.
scenes.caption: आपका ईमेल लगभग हर जगह यूज़रनेम होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A login form on a phone screen, the phone propped against a kettle on a kitchen counter, the email field already filled in and the password field empty, soft morning light from a window.

scenes.narration: By the end you will know which passwords actually need changing.
scenes.caption: अंत तक आप जान जाएंगे कि कौन-सा पासवर्ड बदलना ज़रूरी है।
scenes.image_brief: Four sticky notes stuck to a fridge door, each with a different website name written on it in marker, two of them crossed out, bright even kitchen light.

scenes.narration: Attackers do not guess. They replay. Software tries your pair on hundreds of sites.
scenes.caption: हमलावर अंदाज़ा नहीं लगाते। सॉफ़्टवेयर सैकड़ों साइटों पर वही जोड़ी आज़माता है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen filled with a fast scrolling list of website names, each line marked with a small red cross, in a dark room lit only by the screen.

scenes.narration: One match logs them in. No alarm sounds, because the password was correct.
scenes.caption: एक जगह मेल खाया और लॉगिन हो गया। कोई अलार्म नहीं बजता।
scenes.image_brief: The same laptop screen and the same list, now stopped, with one line marked by a green tick while every other line keeps its red cross, dark room, screen glow only.

scenes.narration: Say you reuse one password across twelve accounts. One leak exposes twelve.
scenes.caption: मान लीजिए बारह खातों पर एक ही पासवर्ड है। एक लीक से बारहों खुल जाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Twelve identical closed padlocks laid out in a grid of four by three on a grey table, one small brass key resting in the middle of the grid, flat even daylight.

scenes.narration: Change it on three. Nine doors stay open, all with the same key.
scenes.caption: तीन बदल दिए? नौ दरवाज़े उसी चाबी से खुले रहते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: The same grey table and grid, but three of the twelve padlocks are now larger and a different shape, the nine matching ones still surrounding the small brass key, flat even daylight.

scenes.narration: Unique passwords do not stop phishing. You can still type one into a fake page.
scenes.caption: अलग पासवर्ड फ़िशिंग नहीं रोकते। नकली पेज पर आप ख़ुद टाइप कर देंगे।
scenes.image_brief: A phone in a desk stand showing a bank login page whose web address in the bar is subtly misspelled, papers and a chipped enamel mug around it, warm evening lamp light.

scenes.narration: And a stolen phone number defeats codes sent by text.
scenes.caption: और नंबर चोरी हो जाए तो एसएमएस के कोड काम नहीं देते।
scenes.image_brief: A phone lying face up on a bedside table showing a text message with a six digit code in it, the rest of the room dark except the screen light on the tabletop.

scenes.narration: Reuse is what turns one company's bad night into your problem.
scenes.caption: दोबारा इस्तेमाल ही किसी कंपनी की गलती को आपकी मुसीबत बनाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A dark server room with two rows of tall machine cabinets, one cabinet door standing open, red and blue status lights reflecting on the polished floor between the rows.

scenes.narration: Unique passwords break that link. A manager remembers them so you do not.
scenes.caption: अलग पासवर्ड यह कड़ी तोड़ देते हैं। मैनेजर उन्हें याद रखता है।
scenes.image_brief: Nine different padlocks of different shapes on a dark wooden desk, each with its own distinct key beside it, and a closed notebook stamped with a lock symbol, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Change your email password first. Everything else resets through it.
scenes.caption: पहले ईमेल का पासवर्ड बदलें। बाकी सब उसी से रीसेट होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a wooden desk showing an email account security screen with a change password button highlighted, a glass of water beside it, soft evening light from a lamp.

title: 📍 Tanvi tapped allow once... the app permission that keeps collecting #privacy #android
title_alts: 🗺 Tanvi's location permission became a daily trail... how that happens #privacy #location
🚫 Tanvi left one permission on always... the setting that fixes it #privacy #apps
description_hook: A permission is not a single yes, it is a standing arrangement. This is how one tap becomes a daily record of where you were.
problem_domain: mobile app permissions and location data
setting: a phone screen and the streets it quietly records
protagonist_type: a phone owner who installs apps without reading

characters.name: Tanvi
characters.description: twenty-six, long hair tied back, olive green jacket, a cracked phone case held together with tape

claims.claim: Your phone can report a location every five minutes.
claims.basis: round illustrative interval chosen for the example, not a platform specification
arithmetic: 1440 minutes in a day divided by the five minute interval already stated

claims.claim: That trail is bundled with thousands of others and sold onward.
claims.basis: illustrative scale for aggregation, deliberately vague because volumes vary by broker

scenes.narration: Permission is not one time. It is a standing invitation.
scenes.caption: परमिशन एक बार की बात नहीं। यह खुला न्योता है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone flat on a wooden table showing a permission dialog with two buttons reading allow and don't allow, a small location arrow icon above them, bright daylight from a window.

scenes.narration: Free apps still have costs. Yours is often the data.
scenes.caption: मुफ़्त एप का भी दाम होता है। वह दाम आपका डेटा है।
scenes.image_brief: An app store listing on a phone screen, the word free in large type under a plain rounded app icon, the phone in a stand on a tidy desk, cool even office light.

scenes.narration: Location, contacts, photos: each one is a separate door.
scenes.caption: लोकेशन, कॉन्टैक्ट, फ़ोटो: हर एक अलग दरवाज़ा है।
scenes.image_brief: Three plain doors side by side in an empty corridor, each with one symbol painted on it, a map pin, an address book and a photograph, even overhead light.

scenes.narration: You will learn which permission to revoke tonight.
scenes.caption: आज रात कौन-सी परमिशन बंद करनी है, यह पता चल जाएगा।
scenes.image_brief: A phone lying on a bedspread showing an app permission list with a column of toggles, one toggle switched off and faintly highlighted, soft lamp light from the side.

scenes.narration: An app with background location can read your position all day.
scenes.caption: बैकग्राउंड लोकेशन वाला एप दिन भर आपकी जगह पढ़ सकता है।
scenes.image_brief: A city map filling a phone screen with a dotted trail of location pins crossing it from one edge to the other, the phone flat on a cafe table beside a saucer, afternoon light.

scenes.narration: That trail is bundled with thousands of others and sold onward.
scenes.caption: वह रास्ता हज़ारों और लोगों के साथ जुड़कर आगे बेचा जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A large city map mounted on the wall of a windowless room, hundreds of faint dotted trails overlapping across it, lit by a single humming ceiling strip light.

scenes.narration: Your phone can report a location every five minutes.
scenes.caption: फ़ोन हर पाँच मिनट में एक लोकेशन भेज सकता है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone and a small round wall clock side by side on a table, the phone screen showing a list of timestamps five minutes apart each with a location pin, cool daylight.

scenes.narration: That is 288 points a day. Home, work, clinic, all obvious.
scenes.caption: यानी दिन के 288 पॉइंट। घर, दफ़्तर, क्लिनिक, सब साफ़।
scenes.image_brief: A printed sheet pinned to a corkboard covered in 288 small dots, three of them circled in red pen and labelled home, work and clinic, plain desk light from above.

scenes.narration: Maps genuinely need location. Revoking it there breaks the app.
scenes.caption: नक्शे वाले एप को लोकेशन सच में चाहिए। बंद करें तो टूट जाएगा।
scenes.image_brief: A navigation map open on a phone clipped to a car dashboard, a blue route line running up the screen, bright daylight coming through the windscreen onto the dashboard.

scenes.narration: The fix is not deleting everything. It is matching access to purpose.
scenes.caption: सब कुल हटाना हल नहीं। ज़रूरत के मुताबिक़ पहुँच देना हल है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a wooden desk showing three location choices listed as never, while using the app, and always, with the middle choice selected, warm light from one side.

scenes.narration: Most apps work fine set to ask every time.
scenes.caption: ज़्यादातर एप हर बार पूँछने वाली सेटिंग पर ठीक चलते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A phone home screen full of app icons on a white table, a tiny grey location arrow sitting beside every icon except one, soft even daylight from above.

scenes.narration: A one-second tap today decides what leaves your phone for years.
scenes.caption: एक सेकंड का टैप तय करता है कि सालों तक क्या बाहर जाएगा।
scenes.image_brief: A phone resting on a sofa cushion with a permission dialog half faded from the screen, the room otherwise dark except a street lamp glowing through the window.

scenes.narration: Open your location settings. Change any always to while using.
scenes.caption: लोकेशन सेटिंग खोलें। हर हमेशा वाली एप को बदल दें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone held upright in a stand on a bedside table showing a full list of apps with their location settings, several rows reading while using the app, warm lamp light.

title: 📶 Devansh trusted the cafe wifi name... the setting that stops this #publicwifi #privacy
title_alts: 🌐 Devansh's saved wifi list rejoins fakes by name... why that works #publicwifi #wifi
🧹 Devansh never forgot an old hotspot... clear this list tonight #publicwifi #privacy
description_hook: A network name is not proof of anything, and your phone rejoins by name alone. The fix is a list you have never cleaned.
setting: a cafe table, an airport hall and a parked car
protagonist_type: a commuter who connects wherever there is signal

characters.name: Devansh
characters.description: forty, greying temples, navy windbreaker, a laptop bag with one broken zip pull

claims.claim: Say you used airport wifi once, two years ago.
claims.basis: round illustrative timeframe for the example, stated as a supposition in the narration

claims.claim: a saved networks list reduced to three entries
claims.basis: illustrative target number used to make the advice concrete, not a recommendation from any standard

scenes.narration: Anyone can name a hotspot after the cafe next door.
scenes.caption: कोई भी अपने हॉटस्पॉट का नाम पडोस के कैफ़े जैसा रख सकता है।
scenes.image_brief: A chalkboard sign on a cafe counter reading Free WiFi with a network name written under it, a coffee machine and stacked cups behind, warm afternoon light from the front window.

scenes.narration: Your phone keeps a list of networks it trusts.
scenes.caption: आपका फ़ोन उन नेटवर्क की सूची रखता है जिन पर वह भरोसा करता है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a long saved networks list with many names stacked down the page, the phone resting on a cafe table beside a half finished coffee, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: It rejoins them by name, silently, whenever one appears.
scenes.caption: नाम देखकर वह चुपचाप दोबारा जुड़ जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone lying face up and untouched on a marble counter with the wifi symbol lit at the top of its screen, bright even light from overhead lamps.

scenes.narration: Which network is the real risk? You will see.
scenes.caption: असली ख़तरा कौन-सा नेटवर्क है? आगे देखिए।
scenes.image_brief: Two identical network names listed one above the other on a phone screen, one with a padlock symbol beside it and one without, the phone on a dark table, cool screen glow.

scenes.narration: A laptop can broadcast that same name from any corner. Your phone matches the name, connects, and routes traffic through it.
scenes.caption: वही नाम कोई लैपटॉप भी चला सकता है। फ़ोन जुड़कर सारा ट्रैफ़िक उसी से भेजता है।
scenes.image_brief: An open laptop on the back seat of a parked car with a small antenna standing beside it, a cafe front visible through the car window, dim interior and bright street outside.

scenes.narration: Say you used airport wifi once, two years ago.
scenes.caption: मान लीजिए दो साल पहले एक बार एयरपोर्ट वाईफ़ाई चलाया था।
scenes.image_brief: An airport departure hall with rows of empty seats and a wall sign showing a wifi symbol above a network name, a suitcase parked by one seat, cold wide ceiling light.

scenes.narration: That name still sits saved. One broadcast and you are back on.
scenes.caption: वह नाम आज भी सेव है। एक बार दिखा और आप जुड़ गए।
scenes.image_brief: A phone tucked in a coat pocket with its screen visible, a connection notice sliding in at the top of the screen, dim evening light on the fabric around it.

scenes.narration: Encrypted sites still protect the contents of what you send. The network still sees where you go.
scenes.caption: कंटेंट तो सुरक्षित रहता है। पर नेटवर्क देखता है कि आप कहाँ गए।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen split between a padlocked address bar at the top and a plain list of visited site names below it, the phone flat on a wooden desk, one warm lamp at the side.

scenes.narration: Forgetting a network is a privacy setting, not housekeeping.
scenes.caption: नेटवर्क भुलाना सफ़ाई नहीं, प्राइवेसी सेटिंग है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone settings screen with one network selected and a forget this network option highlighted, the phone on a kitchen table beside a set of keys, morning light.

scenes.narration: The shorter your saved list, the fewer names anyone can fake.
scenes.caption: सेव सूची जितनी सीमित, नक़ली नाम बनाने की गुंजाइश उतनी कम।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a saved networks list with only three entries at the top and empty space below them, the phone on a bedside table under soft lamp light.

scenes.narration: Open saved networks. Delete every one you will not use again.
scenes.caption: सेव नेटवर्क खोलें। जो दोबारा काम नहीं आएंगे, उन्हें हटा दें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone upright in a stand on a desk showing the saved networks list with a delete confirmation box open over it, a notebook beside the stand, warm evening lamp light.

title: 📱 Ishita's codes arrived by text... why that is the weakest 2fa #2fa #onlinesafety
title_alts: 🔁 Ishita's number moved in a sim swap... how the codes follow #simswap #2fa
⛔ Ishita relied on sms codes... the one switch that stops this #2fa #privacy
description_hook: A phone number is issued to you, not owned by you. That single fact is what makes text message codes the weakest second factor.
problem_domain: two factor authentication and number takeover
setting: a mobile shop counter and a bedside table
protagonist_type: a careful saver who did set up two factor

characters.name: Ishita
characters.description: thirty-eight, shoulder length hair with a centre parting, mustard cardigan, reading glasses pushed up on her head

claims.claim: A transfer request needs your name, number, and a few details.
claims.basis: illustrative summary of a verification step, deliberately unspecific because requirements differ by carrier

claims.claim: Two codes later, your email is theirs.
claims.basis: round illustrative count for the example, chosen to show how few steps it takes

scenes.narration: Your phone number is not really yours. It is assigned.
scenes.caption: आपका फ़ोन नंबर असल में आपका नहीं। वह आपको दिया गया है।
scenes.image_brief: A single sim card lying alone on a dark grey desk beside an empty sim tray and a straightened paperclip, one hard overhead light throwing a sharp shadow.

scenes.narration: Every reset link and code you get flows through that number.
scenes.caption: हर रीसेट लिंक और कोड उसी नंबर से होकर आता है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a stack of notification cards, each holding a short numeric code, the phone on a bedside table in a dark room lit only by the screen.

scenes.narration: So the number is the master key, quietly.
scenes.caption: यानी वह नंबर चुपचाप मास्टर चाबी बन जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: One large old brass key resting on top of a phone on a wooden table, the phone screen showing a mobile number in a plain input field, warm light from one side.

scenes.narration: You will see how attackers move a number, and what blocks it.
scenes.caption: नंबर कैसे हटाया जाता है और क्या रोकता है, यह देखिए।
scenes.image_brief: A mobile shop counter with a queue rope in front of it, a ticket number display on the wall and a board of sim card offers behind, bright fluorescent ceiling light.

scenes.narration: A transfer request needs your name, number, and a few details.
scenes.caption: ट्रांसफ़र के लिए नाम, नंबर और थोड़ी जानकारी चाहिए होती है।
scenes.image_brief: A printed transfer request form on a shop counter with the name, number and address fields partly filled in, a pen lying across it, hard overhead shop light.

scenes.narration: Approve it wrongly and the codes arrive on their phone instead.
scenes.caption: गलती से मंज़ूरी मिली तो कोड उनके फ़ोन पर जाने लगते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Two identical phones side by side on a shop counter, only the right one lit with an incoming code message while the left stays dark, cool light from above.

scenes.narration: Say the attacker has your leaked birth date and address.
scenes.caption: मान लीजिए हमलावर के पास आपकी जन्मतिथि और पता है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing a table of leaked personal records with name, address and date of birth columns, the room dark apart from the screen glow on the desk edge.

scenes.narration: That is often enough. Two codes later, your email is theirs.
scenes.caption: इतना ही काफ़ी है। दो कोड बाद ईमेल उनका हो जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing an email inbox with a password changed notice at the top of the list, in a dark room, the screen light falling on the back of an empty chair.

scenes.narration: Are text codes useless? No. They still beat one factor alone.
scenes.caption: एसएमएस कोड बेकार हैं? नहीं। अकेले पासवर्ड से तो बेहतर हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a kitchen table showing a two step verification screen with the text message option selected and an app option below it, morning light through a window.

scenes.narration: But an app code lives on the device, not the network.
scenes.caption: पर एप वाला कोड डिवाइस में रहता है, नेटवर्क में नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A phone flat on an open notebook showing an authenticator app with a six digit code and a small countdown ring beside it, warm desk lamp light from the left.

scenes.narration: The factor you can lose to a phone shop is the weakest one.
scenes.caption: जो फ़ैक्टर किसी दुकान पर खो सकता है, वही सबसे कमज़ोर है।
scenes.image_brief: A closed mobile shop shutter with a sim card poster pasted on it, a street lamp above throwing a cone of light down onto the empty pavement at night.

scenes.narration: An authenticator app cannot be transferred by a stranger's phone call.
scenes.caption: ऑथेंटिकेटर एप किसी अजनबी के फ़ोन कॉल से नहीं बदलता।
scenes.image_brief: A phone in a stand showing an authenticator code, and behind it a landline handset lying off its cradle on the same desk, dim evening light from one lamp.

scenes.narration: Add a port-out PIN with your carrier today.
scenes.caption: अपने ऑपरेटर से पोर्ट-आउट पिन आज ही लगवाएं।
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a desk showing a carrier account security page with a port out PIN field filled with dots, a folded bill envelope beside it, soft daylight from a window.

title: 📷 Aarav shared the original photo file... strip the metadata first #photos #privacy
title_alts: 🧭 Aarav's photo carried hidden gps coordinates... how metadata travels #photos #metadata
🚪 Aarav sent the photo, not a screenshot... one tap prevents this #photos #privacy
description_hook: A photo file carries more than the picture. Here is what rides along inside it, and the one habit that leaves it behind.
setting: a desk, a laptop and the street outside a building
protagonist_type: someone selling things through chat apps

characters.name: Aarav
characters.description: twenty-nine, close-cropped hair, faded blue denim shirt, a camera strap worn shiny at one edge

claims.claim: The coordinates land within ten metres.
claims.basis: round illustrative accuracy for consumer satellite positioning, used to make the example concrete

claims.claim: The camera stores time, model, and GPS position in hidden fields.
claims.basis: describes the kind of fields a photo file can carry, not a count or a measurement

scenes.narration: Your camera writes your coordinates inside the photo file.
scenes.caption: कैमरा आपकी लोकेशन फ़ोटो की फ़ाइल के अंदर लिख देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A photo file open in a details panel on a laptop screen showing latitude and longitude values in a list of properties, dim room, screen light spilling onto the desk.

scenes.narration: That file travels whole when you send it as a document.
scenes.caption: डॉक्युमेंट की तरह भेजने पर फ़ाइल पूरी की पूरी जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone chat screen showing one file attachment card with a long file name and a size label under it, the phone on a wooden table, soft afternoon light.

scenes.narration: A shared photo can name the exact spot it was taken.
scenes.caption: साझा की गई फ़ोटो ठीक वही जगह बता सकती है।
scenes.image_brief: A printed street photograph pinned to a corkboard with a red map pin pushed through one corner of it, plain wall behind, even daylight from the left.

scenes.narration: Which apps keep the location? That is the whole trick.
scenes.caption: कौन-से एप लोकेशन रखते हैं? यही पूरा खेल है।
scenes.image_brief: Two phone screens side by side on a grey table, the left showing an upload progress bar and the right showing a chat attachment card, cool even light from above.

scenes.narration: The camera stores time, model, and GPS position in hidden fields.
scenes.caption: कैमरा समय, मॉडल और जीपीएस जगह को छिपे खानों में रखता है।
scenes.image_brief: A camera body lying on a desk with its memory card ejected and resting beside it, a lens cap nearby, hard light from one overhead bulb making sharp shadows.

scenes.narration: Nothing displays them. Any viewer app can read them anyway.
scenes.caption: ये दिखते नहीं। पर कोई भी व्यूअर एप इन्हें पढ़ सकता है।
scenes.image_brief: A photograph displayed full screen on a laptop with an information panel open beside it listing a time, a camera model and a pair of coordinates, dark room, screen glow.

scenes.narration: Say you photograph a bike for sale outside your building.
scenes.caption: मान लीजिए इमारत के बाहर बिकने वाली साइकिल की फ़ोटो ली।
scenes.image_brief: A bicycle with a small for sale card tied to its handlebars, parked against the compound wall of an apartment building, bright late afternoon sunlight.

scenes.narration: The coordinates land within ten metres. That is your doorstep.
scenes.caption: लोकेशन दस मीटर के अंदर आ जाती है। यानी आपका दरवाज़ा।
scenes.image_brief: A map on a laptop screen zoomed in on a single building with one pin dropped on its front gate and a scale bar reading ten metres in the corner, dim desk light.

scenes.narration: Big platforms usually strip this when you upload. Chat apps sending the original file often do not.
scenes.caption: बड़े प्लैटफ़ॉर्म अपलोड पर इसे हटा देते हैं। चैट एप मूल फ़ाइल भेजें तो नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a social upload panel at the top and a chat window below it holding an original file attachment, cool indoor light, phone flat on a desk.

scenes.narration: One screenshot of the photo removes every hidden field.
scenes.caption: फ़ोटो का स्क्रीनशॉट हर छिपा खाना हटा देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a screenshot preview of a bicycle photo with an empty details panel open beside it, the phone resting on a notebook, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Privacy here is a habit, not a setting you find once.
scenes.caption: यहाँ प्राइवेसी आदत है, एक बार की सेटिंग नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A tidy desk with a phone, a camera and a closed notebook lined up in a row, a set of keys hanging from a wall hook above them, soft morning light.

scenes.narration: Before you send a house photo, screenshot it and send that.
scenes.caption: घर की फ़ोटो भेजने से पहले स्क्रीनशॉट लें, वही भेजें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone in a stand showing a chat window where a screenshot of a house photo has just been sent and marked delivered, warm evening lamp light on the desk.

title: 🧹 Anaya forgot five old accounts... the one you must close first #databreach #privacy
title_alts: 📦 Anaya's dormant accounts still store her card... how that leaks #privacy #accounts
⏳ Anaya never closed the old signups... the cleanup that prevents this #privacy #accounts
description_hook: You cannot be careful on behalf of a website you forgot you joined. This is how to find the old accounts still holding your details.
setting: an email inbox and a dusty storeroom of old records
protagonist_type: a long-time internet user with a decade of signups

characters.name: Anaya
characters.description: forty-five, hair in a low bun, rust coloured kurta, a pair of reading glasses on a beaded chain

claims.claim: Most people find thirty forgotten signups.
claims.basis: round illustrative figure for what an inbox search turns up, offered as a typical case not a measurement
round illustrative assumption, stated as such in the narration
round illustrative number in the title framing, no source claimed

scenes.narration: Accounts you never open still hold everything you once gave them.
scenes.caption: जिन खातों को आप खोलते भी नहीं, वे सब कुछ संभाले बैठे हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A dusty cardboard storage box on a high shelf with old paper forms sticking out from under the lid, dim storeroom light coming from one small high window.

scenes.narration: Old profiles keep addresses, card digits, and old photos.
scenes.caption: पुरानी प्रोफ़ाइल में पता, कार्ड के अंक और पुरानी फ़ोटो पड़ी रहती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing an old account profile page with a saved postal address and a card number ending in four digits, the room lit only by the screen.

scenes.narration: You stopped logging in. The company did not stop storing your data.
scenes.caption: आपने लॉगिन बंद किया। कंपनी ने डेटा रखना बंद नहीं किया।
scenes.image_brief: A dark server cabinet with one drive tray pulled halfway out, small green lights blinking in a line along its front, cold blue light in a windowless room.

scenes.narration: You will learn how to shrink that surface in one evening.
scenes.caption: एक शाम में यह दायरा कैसे छोटा करें, यह सीखेंगे।
scenes.image_brief: A kitchen table with a phone, a mug and a notepad holding a handwritten list of website names, two names already struck through with a pen, evening lamp light.

scenes.narration: How many accounts are still live? Each one is a database that can leak.
scenes.caption: कितने खाते अब भी चालू हैं? हर एक लीक होने वाला डेटाबेस है।
scenes.image_brief: Rows of identical dark server cabinets stretching down a narrow aisle, one cabinet door standing open, hard overhead strip lights reflecting on the floor.

scenes.narration: A leak there exposes data you forgot you ever typed.
scenes.caption: वहाँ लीक हुआ तो वह डेटा खुलेगा जो आप भूल भी गए थे।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing an old forum profile with a faded photograph and a home address field visible on it, dim room, screen light falling across a keyboard.

scenes.narration: Search your inbox for the word welcome. Then count the results.
scenes.caption: इनबॉक्स में वेलकम शब्द खोजें। फिर नतीजे गिनें।
scenes.image_brief: An email search box on a laptop screen with the word welcome typed into it and a long list of results filling the page below, warm desk lamp light from the right.

scenes.narration: Most people find thirty forgotten signups. Maybe three still matter.
scenes.caption: ज़्यादातर लोगों को तीस भूले साइनअप मिलते हैं। तीन ही मायने रखते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A printed list of thirty website names taped to a plain wall, three of the names circled in red marker and the rest left untouched, even flat daylight.

scenes.narration: Deleting is not always an option. Some services only deactivate.
scenes.caption: डिलीट हर जगह मुमकिन नहीं। कई सेवाएं सिर्य् निष्क्रिय करती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A settings page on a laptop screen showing a deactivate account button with no delete option anywhere beside it, dark room lit only by the screen.

scenes.narration: Then the work is emptying the account: address, card, photos.
scenes.caption: तब काम यह है: पता, कार्ड, फ़ोटो सब ख़ुद हटा दें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing an account details form with the address and card fields cleared and empty, the phone on a desk beside a capped pen, cool daylight.

scenes.narration: Your real risk is not how careful you are this week.
scenes.caption: असली जोखिम यह नहीं कि आप इस हफ़्ते कितने सतर्क हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A new laptop bag with a small padlock through its zip sitting on a tidy desk, and behind it a stack of dusty old folders, soft daylight from a window.

scenes.narration: It is how many old copies of you are still sitting online.
scenes.caption: जोखिम यह है कि आपकी कितनी पुरानी कॉपियाँ ऑनलाइन पड़ी हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Identical cardboard boxes stacked to the ceiling along a dim warehouse aisle, each box labelled with a different website name, one bare bulb lighting the aisle.

scenes.narration: Search welcome, pick the oldest one, and delete that account tonight.
scenes.caption: वेलकम खोजें, सबसे पुराना खाता चुनें, और आज ही हटा दें।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing a final delete account confirmation box over an old profile page, a mug of tea beside the laptop, warm evening lamp light on the desk.

title: 📶 Arjun’s public Wi‑Fi trap… avoids data theft
title_alts: 📶 Arjun stops Wi‑Fi snooping… secures his traffic
📶 Arjun’s hotspot mistake… blocks hackers
description_hook: Connecting to free Wi‑Fi can expose every bit of your data. Discover the one setting that shields you instantly.

characters.name: Arjun
characters.description: early‑30s, glasses, laptop sleeve, focused eyes

scenes.narration: Open Wi‑Fi lets strangers see everything you type.
scenes.caption: ओपन वाई‑फ़ाई से हर लिखी चीज़ दिखती है।
scenes.image_brief: Laptop on a cafe table with Wi‑Fi symbol floating above, soft indoor lighting.

scenes.narration: Most think HTTPS alone protects their data fully.
scenes.caption: अधिकांश लोग HTTPS को पूरी सुरक्षा मानते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Browser address bar showing https:// in green, bright screen.

scenes.narration: But DNS queries still travel unencrypted on public networks.
scenes.caption: पर DNS क्वेरी अभी भी अनएन्क्रिप्टेड रहती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Diagram of DNS request leaving a laptop to a cloud, with a red line indicating exposure.

scenes.narration: You’ll learn a single toggle that encrypts all traffic automatically.
scenes.caption: आप एक टॉगल सीखेंगे जो सभी ट्रैफ़िक को एन्क्रिप्ट कर देगा।
scenes.image_brief: Toggle switch icon labeled ‘Secure DNS’, glowing green.

scenes.narration: Enable DNS‑over‑HTTPS in your device’s network settings.
scenes.caption: डिवाइस सेटिंग में DNS‑over‑HTTPS चालू करें।
scenes.image_brief: Phone settings screen highlighting DNS‑over‑HTTPS option, clean UI.

scenes.narration: The system routes queries through encrypted servers, hiding sites you visit.
scenes.caption: सिस्टम क्वेरी को एन्क्रिप्टेड सर्वर से भेजता है, साइट छिपती है।
scenes.image_brief: Encrypted tunnel graphic connecting laptop to DNS server, dark background.

scenes.narration: Arjun turned on Secure DNS and a password manager login stayed private.
scenes.caption: अर्जुन ने Secure DNS चालू किया, पासवर्ड लॉगिन सुरक्षित रहा।
scenes.image_brief: Laptop screen showing password manager login success, lock icon overlay.

scenes.narration: Even a hacker on the same hotspot saw only encrypted blobs.
scenes.caption: हैकर को सिर्फ एन्क्रिप्टेड डेटा दिखा।
scenes.image_brief: Another laptop with red warning sign over its screen, indicating failed sniffing.

scenes.narration: If the network blocks custom DNS, the setting reverts silently.
scenes.caption: यदि नेटवर्क कस्टम DNS ब्लॉक करे, सेटिंग चुपचाप रिवर्ट होती है।
scenes.image_brief: Network error popup stating ‘DNS blocked’, gray tones.

scenes.narration: Don’t rely on VPNs that leak DNS unless they support full tunnel mode.
scenes.caption: VPN भी DNS लीक कर सकते हैं, फुल टनल मोड जरूरी है।
scenes.image_brief: VPN app window with a warning ‘DNS leak detected’ highlighted.

scenes.narration: Now Arjun browses cafés without fearing data harvesters.
scenes.caption: अब अर्जुन कैफ़े में बिना डेटा चोरी की चिंता के ब्राउज़ करता है।
scenes.image_brief: Arjun smiling at laptop, coffee steam, bright morning light.

scenes.narration: His credentials stay invisible, even on the busiest hotspot.
scenes.caption: उसके क्रेडेंशियल भीड़भाड़ वाले हॉटस्पॉट में भी अदृश्य रहते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Heat map of Wi‑Fi users, Arjun’s laptop highlighted in green, others in red.

scenes.narration: Open your settings now, enable Secure DNS, and surf safely.
scenes.caption: सेटिंग खोलें, Secure DNS चालू करें, सुरक्षित सर्फ़ करें।
scenes.image_brief: Step‑by‑step overlay showing the toggle being switched on, bright colors.

title: 🔐 Maya’s two‑factor slip… stops account hijack
title_alts: 🔐 Maya avoids 2FA fail… protects her accounts
🔐 Maya’s 2FA mistake… blocks hackers
description_hook: A single oversight in two‑factor authentication can hand over your accounts to attackers. Learn the exact step to secure them.

characters.name: Maya
characters.description: late‑20s, short black hair, casual hoodie, focused expression

scenes.narration: A hacked email costs millions worldwide each year.
scenes.caption: हैक्ड ईमेल हर साल करोड़ों का नुकसान करते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Close‑up of a laptop screen showing a warning alert, dark room, blue glow.

scenes.narration: Most users think a code sent by SMS is enough protection.
scenes.caption: अधिकांश उपयोगकर्ता एसएमएस कोड को पर्याप्त सुरक्षा मानते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Smartphone displaying a text message with a 6‑digit code, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: But carriers can intercept those messages without you knowing.
scenes.caption: पर कैरियर्स बिना आपके ज्ञान के संदेश पकड़ सकते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Illustration of a cellular tower with signal lines reaching a phone, muted colors.

scenes.narration: You’ll see a simple change that blocks that loophole completely.
scenes.caption: आप एक सरल बदलाव देखेंगे जो इस खामी को पूरी तरह बंद कर देगा।
scenes.image_brief: Animated lock icon closing over a phone screen, clean white background.

scenes.narration: Use an authenticator app that generates codes on your device.
scenes.caption: ऐप से कोड जनरेट करें, जो आपके डिवाइस पर बनते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Smartphone showing Google Authenticator app with rotating codes, soft lighting.

scenes.narration: The app stores secrets locally, never sending them over the network.
scenes.caption: ऐप रहस्य स्थानीय रूप से रखता है, नेटवर्क पर नहीं भेजता।
scenes.image_brief: Diagram of a phone with a shield, arrows indicating internal storage only.

scenes.narration: Maya switched from SMS to Authy and stopped a fraud attempt instantly.
scenes.caption: माया ने Authy पर स्विच किया और तुरंत धोखाधड़ी रोकी।
scenes.image_brief: Side‑by‑side comparison: left shows a failed SMS login, right shows a successful Authy login.

scenes.narration: Her account remained safe while a nearby SIM clone failed to deliver the code.
scenes.caption: उसका खाता सुरक्षित रहा जबकि सिम क्लोन कोड नहीं पहुँचा पाया।
scenes.image_brief: Illustration of a fake SIM card trying to receive a message, but the phone shows 'code not received'.

scenes.narration: If you lose your phone, the backup codes become crucial.
scenes.caption: फ़ोन खोने पर बैकअप कोड महत्वपूर्ण हो जाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Paper with printed backup codes beside a phone, neutral lighting.

scenes.narration: Don’t store those codes in cloud notes; they become another attack vector.
scenes.caption: बैकअप कोड क्लाउड नोट्स में न रखें; यह नया खतरा बनता है।
scenes.image_brief: Cloud icon with a red warning sign over a note app screenshot.

scenes.narration: Now Maya’s accounts stay locked behind a barrier SMS can’t breach.
scenes.caption: अब माया के खाते SMS से नहीं तोड़े जा सकते।
scenes.image_brief: Secure vault door closing over a digital account icon, strong lighting.

scenes.narration: She avoids the nightmare of identity theft and data loss.
scenes.caption: वह पहचान चोरी और डेटा हानि के दुःस्वप्न से बचती है।
scenes.image_brief: Person relaxed at desk, sunlight through window, laptop showing a green shield.

scenes.narration: Install an authenticator app today and back up your codes safely.
scenes.caption: आज ही एक ऑथेंटिकेटर ऐप इंस्टॉल करें और कोड सुरक्षित रखें।
scenes.image_brief: App store page highlighting an authenticator app, bright and inviting.

title: 📱 Priya’s app‑close myth… stops battery drain
title_alts: 📱 Priya debunks background kill… saves power
📱 Priya’s false app‑close belief… protects battery
description_hook: Swiping apps away doesn’t stop them from draining power. Find the real trick to extend your phone’s battery life.

characters.name: Priya
characters.description: mid‑20s, ponytail, pajamas, focused on phone

scenes.narration: A dead phone at night can ruin tomorrow’s plans.
scenes.caption: रात में बैटरी ख़त्म होने से अगले दिन की योजना बिगड़ती है।
scenes.image_brief: Phone screen dark on a nightstand, moonlight through window.

scenes.narration: Most think closing apps removes their background activity.
scenes.caption: अधिकांश मानते हैं ऐप बंद करने से बैकग्राउंड बंद हो जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: Finger swiping up on a phone, app icons disappearing.

scenes.narration: Android actually keeps them in memory for quick relaunch.
scenes.caption: एंड्रॉइड उन्हें मेमोरी में रखता है त्वरित पुनः लॉन्च के लिए।
scenes.image_brief: Diagram of RAM blocks labeled ‘cached apps’ inside phone silhouette.

scenes.narration: You’ll learn one setting that truly stops hidden drains.
scenes.caption: आप एक सेटिंग सीखेंगे जो असली ड्रेन रोकता है।
scenes.image_brief: Gear icon with a droplet crossed out, bright green.

scenes.narration: Disable background activity for power‑hungry apps in Battery settings.
scenes.caption: बैटरी सेटिंग में पावर‑हंवी ऐप की बैकग्राउंड बंद करें।
scenes.image_brief: Phone battery settings screen highlighting ‘Background activity’ toggle.

scenes.narration: The OS then freezes the app’s processes until you open it again.
scenes.caption: OS तब तक प्रक्रिया को फ्रीज़ करता है जब तक आप ऐप न खोलें।
scenes.image_brief: Illustration of a frozen clock over an app icon, icy blue tones.

scenes.narration: Priya turned off background sync for a social app and saved 15 % battery per night.
scenes.caption: प्रिया ने सोशल ऐप की बैकग्राउंड बंद की, रात में 15 % बचत।
scenes.image_brief: Battery percentage chart showing rise from 55 % to 70 % overnight.

scenes.narration: That equals almost three extra hours of screen time weekly.
scenes.caption: यह साप्ताहिक तीन अतिरिक्त घंटे स्क्रीन समय देता है।
scenes.image_brief: Clock hands moving three hours forward, bright overlay on phone.

scenes.narration: If you need real‑time notifications, you must allow background for that app.
scenes.caption: रियल‑टाइम नोटिफ़िकेशन के लिए कुछ ऐप को बैकग्राउंड चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: Notification bell icon with a small ‘allowed’ badge.

scenes.narration: Turning off all background activity can break location‑based services.
scenes.caption: सभी बैकग्राउंड बंद करने से लोकेशन सेवाएँ टूट सकती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Map pin fading out on a phone screen, warning sign.

scenes.narration: Now Priya wakes up to a fully charged phone, ready for the day.
scenes.caption: अब प्रिया पूरी चार्ज्ड फ़ोन के साथ दिन शुरू करती है।
scenes.image_brief: Morning light, phone showing 100 % battery, coffee mug beside it.

scenes.narration: Her phone lasts through meetings, rides, and evening streams.
scenes.caption: फ़ोन मीटिंग, यात्रा, और शाम के स्ट्रीम तक चलता है।
scenes.image_brief: Timeline of day activities with phone battery staying high, vibrant colors.

scenes.narration: Open Battery settings now, toggle off background for unused apps.
scenes.caption: बैटरी सेटिंग खोलें, अनयूज़्ड ऐप की बैकग्राउंड बंद करें।
scenes.image_brief: Step‑by‑step overlay showing the toggle being switched off, encouraging colors.

title: ⚡ Ravi’s cloud‑bucket fee… reveals hidden 70 % cost rise
title_alts: ⚡ Ravi avoids surprise cloud fees… saves money
⚡ Ravi’s storage mistake… cuts unexpected expenses
description_hook: Storing files in the cloud can silently inflate your bill. Discover the metric that uncovers hidden transfer fees.

characters.name: Ravi
characters.description: late‑30s, beard, casual shirt, focused on monitor

scenes.narration: A 500 GB bucket can cost three times more than expected.
scenes.caption: 500 GB बकेट की लागत तीन गुना अधिक हो सकती है।
scenes.image_brief: Cloud storage icon with a price tag multiplying, neutral background.

scenes.narration: Most users assume storage price equals the amount saved.
scenes.caption: अधिकांश मानते हैं स्टोरेज कीमत समान है जितनी सेव की जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: Bar chart comparing storage size vs. cost, simple lines.

scenes.narration: But egress fees charge for data you download or move out.
scenes.caption: पर एग्रेस फ़ीज़ डेटा निकालने पर चार्ज करते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Arrow leaving a cloud with a dollar sign, indicating outbound transfer.

scenes.narration: You’ll see a single metric to track and control those fees.
scenes.caption: आप एक मीट्रिक देखेंगे जो फ़ीज़ को ट्रैक और नियंत्रित करे।
scenes.image_brief: Dashboard widget labeled ‘Egress GB/month’ glowing green.

scenes.narration: Enable lifecycle rules that archive rarely accessed files to cold storage.
scenes.caption: कम उपयोग फ़ाइलों को कोल्ड स्टोरेज में आर्काइव करें।
scenes.image_brief: File icons moving from a hot cloud to a frosty archive box.

scenes.narration: Cold storage has near‑zero egress cost, saving money on downloads.
scenes.caption: कोल्ड स्टोरेज के एग्रेस फ़ीज़ नगण्य होते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Comparison chart showing hot vs. cold storage egress cost, cold line near zero.

scenes.narration: Ravi set a rule moving 200 GB of old logs to cold storage each month.
scenes.caption: रवि ने 200 GB पुराने लॉग को कोल्ड में भेजा।
scenes.image_brief: Timeline showing log files shifting to cold tier, green checkmarks.

scenes.narration: His monthly bill dropped from $120 to $45, a 62 % reduction.
scenes.caption: उसका बिल $120 से $45 हुआ, 62 % घटा।
scenes.image_brief: Invoice screenshot with before/after amounts, red arrow down.

scenes.narration: If you need instant access, cold storage adds retrieval latency.
scenes.caption: तुरंत एक्सेस चाहिए तो कोल्ड स्टोरेज में देरी होती है।
scenes.image_brief: Clock with hourglass overlay on a cold storage icon.

scenes.narration: Never archive files you must edit daily; the cost shift defeats purpose.
scenes.caption: डेली एडिट फ़ाइलें आर्काइव न करें, खर्च उल्टा हो जाएगा।
scenes.image_brief: Editable document icon with a cross over a cold storage box.

scenes.narration: Now Ravi’s cloud spend aligns with his actual usage, no surprise fees.
scenes.caption: अब रवि के क्लाउड खर्च वास्तविक उपयोग से मेल खाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Ravi smiling at a monitor showing a stable cost graph, warm lighting.

scenes.narration: He can reinvest the saved $75 into new projects each quarter.
scenes.caption: वह बचत $75 को नई परियोजनाओं में निवेश करता है।
scenes.image_brief: Stack of coins growing, arrow pointing to a project timeline.

scenes.narration: Set up a lifecycle rule today and watch your cloud bill shrink.
scenes.caption: लाइफ़साइकिल नियम आज सेट करें, बिल घटता देखें।
scenes.image_brief: Step‑by‑step UI showing rule creation, green ‘Save’ button highlighted.
